The investment thesis

A credible wedge, early evidence—and execution still to prove.

FlowPilot pairs fast deployment with growing recurring revenue in a focused mid-market category. The case now depends on scaling delivery without weakening retention, security, or qualification.

Fictional test material

Market: internal estimates may overstate demand.

Competition: larger vendors can bundle; cheaper tools may be sufficient.

Platform: integrations depend on third-party APIs.

Execution: implementation, security, hiring, retention, and conversion must scale together.
